name: Westminster Abbey (British Columbia)
scope: Standing abbey church, Pfitzer Memorial Bell Tower and immediately adjoining monastery and Seminary of Christ the King buildings at Mission, British Columbia.
era: Standing postwar abbey complex in Mission.

originalReview.notes: Original church approach with folded vertical concrete faces, pointed stained-glass windows, projecting ribs, a low brick entrance and a sheltered wooden door. The lower walls are partly screened by trees.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and public-domain first release by the photographer.
review.notes: The exact native Qualla image was verified by SHA-1, byte count and Korman’s author release. Mapped footprints, the original NRCan elevation grids and published abbey dimensions establish the remaining exterior masses.
